Package io.github.jspinak.brobot.analysis.match

Class MatchFusion

java.lang.Object
io.github.jspinak.brobot.analysis.match.MatchFusion
@Component public class MatchFusion extends Object
Combines overlapping or closely positioned matches into single unified matches.

Match fusion is a critical post-processing step that prevents duplicate detections and improves result quality by merging matches that likely represent the same UI element. The fusion process iteratively combines matches based on configurable distance thresholds and fusion strategies.

Key features:

  • Supports multiple fusion strategies (absolute size, relative size)
  • Iterative fusion until no more matches can be combined
  • Preserves match names through string fusion
  • Configurable distance thresholds for X and Y axes

Important: Fused matches lose their original pattern, state object, and other metadata. If this information is needed, perform fusion on a copy of the matches or retain the original matches separately.

  • Method Details

    • setFusedMatches

      public void setFusedMatches(ActionResult matches)
      Applies match fusion to the provided ActionResult if fusion is enabled.

      This method modifies the match list in-place by replacing all matches with their fused equivalents. The fusion process continues iteratively until no more matches can be combined. If fusion method is set to NONE, no changes are made.

      Parameters:
      matches - The ActionResult containing matches to fuse. The match list within this object is modified in-place with fused results.

    • getFinalFusedMatchObjects

      public List<Match> getFinalFusedMatchObjects(ActionResult matches)
      Performs complete iterative fusion of matches until no more can be combined.

      This method repeatedly applies the fusion algorithm until a stable state is reached where no additional matches can be fused. This ensures that all possible combinations are found, even when initial fusion creates new opportunities for further fusion.

      Parameters:
      matches - The ActionResult containing the matches to fuse and the fusion configuration in its ActionConfig
      Returns:
      A new list containing the fully fused matches. The original matches in the ActionResult are not modified.

    • getFusedMatchObjects

      public List<Match> getFusedMatchObjects(List<Match> matchList, ActionConfig actionConfig)
      Performs one iteration of match fusion on the provided match list.

      This method implements the core fusion algorithm, examining each match to find others that should be combined with it based on the fusion strategy and distance thresholds. The algorithm:

      1. Processes each unallocated match as a potential fusion seed
      2. Iteratively expands the seed by fusing nearby matches
      3. Creates a new combined match with merged regions and concatenated names
      4. Continues until all matches have been allocated to fusion groups

      The fusion decision is delegated to the configured MatchFusionDecider, allowing for different fusion strategies. Match names are preserved and combined using string fusion to maintain traceability.

      Parameters:
      matchList - The list of matches to fuse. This list is not modified.
      actionConfig - Configuration containing the fusion method and distance thresholds (maxFusionDistanceX, maxFusionDistanceY)
      Returns:
      A new list containing the fused matches. May be smaller than the input list if matches were combined.
